meta.name: Bad Boy Billionaires India
meta.description: This investigative docuseries explores the greed, fraud, and corruption that built up - and ultimately brought down - India's most infamous tycoons.

videos.title: The King of Good Times
videos.overview: Beer baron and airline owner Vijay Mallya builds a brand image of excess till his Kingfisher empire plunges into alleged money laundering and debt.

videos.title: Diamonds Aren't Forever
videos.overview: Dazzling the world’s elite to globalize his jewelry brand, Nirav Modi is suspected of illegally inflating diamond prices.

videos.title: The World's Biggest Family
videos.overview: Subrata Roy takes his Sahara India Pariwar conglomerate to dizzying heights before facing accusations of enticing poor investors into a pyramid scheme.
